text.2:168: O mankind! Eat of that which is lawful and wholesome in the earth, and follow not the footsteps of the devil. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
text.2:208: O ye who believe! Come, all of you, into submission (unto Him); and follow not the footsteps of the devil. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
text.3:164: Allah verily hath shown grace to the believers by sending unto them a messenger of their own who reciteth unto them His revelations, and causeth them to grow, and teacheth them the Scripture and wisdom; although before (he came to them) they were in flagrant error.
text.4:20: And if ye wish to exchange one wife for another and ye have given unto one of them a sum of money (however great), take nothing from it. Would ye take it by the way of calumny and open wrong?
text.4:50: See, how they invent lies about Allah! That of itself is flagrant sin.
text.4:91: Ye will find others who desire that they should have security from you, and security from their own folk. So often as they are returned to hostility they are plunged therein. If they keep not aloof from you nor offer you peace nor hold their hands, then take them and kill them wherever ye find them. Against such We have given you clear warrant.
text.4:101: And when ye go forth in the land, it is no sin for you to curtail (your) worship if ye fear that those who disbelieve may attack you. In truth the disbelievers are an open enemy to you.
text.4:112: And whoso committeth a delinquency or crime, then throweth (the blame) thereof upon the innocent, hath burdened himself with falsehood and a flagrant crime.
text.4:119: And surely I will lead them astray, and surely I will arouse desires in them, and surely I will command them and they will cut the cattle' ears, and surely I will command them and they will change Allah's creation. Whoso chooseth Satan for a patron instead of Allah is verily a loser and his loss is manifest.
text.4:144: O ye who believe! Choose not disbelievers for (your) friends in place of believers. Would ye give Allah a clear warrant against you?
text.4:153: The people of the Scripture ask of thee that thou shouldst cause an (actual) Book to descend upon them from heaven. They asked a greater thing of Moses aforetime, for they said: Show us Allah plainly. The storm of lightning seized them for their wickedness. Then (even) after that) they chose the calf (for worship) after clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) had come unto them. And We forgave them that! And We bestowed on Moses evident authority.
text.4:174: O mankind! Now hath a proof from your Lord come unto you, and We have sent down unto you a clear light;
text.5:15: O People of the Scripture! Now hath Our messenger come unto you, expounding unto you much of that which ye used to hide in the Scripture, and forgiving much. now hath come unto you light from Allah and plain Scripture,
text.5:92: Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and beware! But if ye turn away, then know that the duty of Our messenger is only plain conveyance (of the message).
text.5:110: When Allah saith: O Jesus, son of Mary! Remember My favour unto thee and unto thy mother; how I strengthened thee with the holy Spirit, so that thou spakest unto mankind in the cradle as in maturity; and how I taught thee the Scripture and Wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and how thou didst shape of clay as it were the likeness of a bird by My permission, and didst blow upon it and it was a bird by My permission, and thou didst heal him who was born blind and the leper by My permission; and how thou didst raise the dead by My permission; and how I restrained the Children of Israel from (harming) thee when thou camest unto them with clear proofs, and those of them who disbelieved exclaimed: This is naught else than mere magic;
text.6:7: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic.
text.6:16: He from whom (such retribution) is averted on that day, (Allah) hath in truth had mercy on him. That will be the signal triumph.
text.6:59: And with Him are the keys of the Invisible. None but He knoweth them. And He knoweth what is in the land and the sea. Not a leaf falleth but He knoweth it, not a grain amid the darkness of the earth, naught of wet or dry but (it is noted) in a clear record.
text.6:74: (Remember) when Abraham said unto his father Azar: Takest thou idols for gods? Lo! I see thee and thy folk in error manifest.
text.6:142: And of the cattle (He produceth) some for burdens, some for food. Eat of that which Allah hath bestowed upon you, and follow not the footsteps of the devil, for lo! he is an open foe to you.
text.7:22: Thus did he lead them on with guile. And when they tasted of the tree their shame was manifest to them and they began to hide (by heaping) on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And their Lord called them, (saying): Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you: Lo! Satan is an open enemy to you?
text.7:60: The chieftains of his people said: Lo! we see thee surely in plain error.
text.7:107: Then he flung down his staff and lo! it was a serpent manifest;
text.7:184: Have they not bethought them (that) there is no madness in their comrade? He is but a plain warner.
text.10:2: Is it a wonder for mankind that We have inspired a man among them, saying: Warn mankind and bring unto those who believe the good tidings that they have a sure footing with their Lord? The disbelievers say: Lo! this is a mere wizard.
text.10:61: And thou (Muhammad) art not occupied with any business and thou recitest not a Lecture from this (Scripture), and ye (mankind) perform no act, but We are Witness of you when ye are engaged therein. And not an atom's weight in the earth or in the sky escapeth your Lord, nor what is less than that or greater than that, but it is (written) in a clear Book.
text.10:76: And when the Truth from Our presence came unto them, they said: Lo! this is mere magic.
text.11:6: And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record.
text.11:7: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days - and His Throne was upon the water - that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct. Yet if thou (O Muhammad) sayest: Lo! ye will be raised again after death! those who disbelieve will surely say: This is naught but mere magic.
text.11:25: And We sent Noah unto his folk (and he said): Lo! I am a plain warner unto you.
text.11:96: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant
text.12:1: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verse of the Scripture that maketh plain.
text.12:5: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.
text.12:8: When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be. Lo! our father is in plain aberration.
text.12:30: And women in the city said: The ruler's wife is asking of her slave-boy an ill-deed. Indeed he has smitten her to the heart with love. We behold her in plain aberration.
text.14:10: Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant.
text.15:1: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
text.15:18: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
text.15:79: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
text.15:89: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
text.16:4: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
text.16:35: And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)?
text.16:82: Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message).
text.16:103: And We know well that they say: Only a man teacheth him. The speech of him at whom they falsely hint is outlandish, and this is clear Arabic speech.
text.17:53: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.
text.19:38: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
text.21:54: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
text.22:11: And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss.
text.22:49: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.
text.23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
text.24:12: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?
text.24:25: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.
text.24:54: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly.
text.26:2: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
text.26:30: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
text.26:32: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
text.26:97: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
text.26:115: I am only a plain warner.
text.27:1: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
text.27:13: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
text.27:16: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.
text.27:21: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.
text.27:75: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.
text.27:79: Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.
text.28:2: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
text.28:15: And he entered the city at a time of carelessness of its folk, and he found therein two men fighting, one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies; and he who was of his caste asked him for help against him who was of his enemies. So Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: This is of the devil's doing. Lo! he is an enemy, a mere misleader.
text.28:18: And morning found him in the city, fearing, vigilant, when behold! he who had appealed to him the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said unto him: Lo! thou art indeed a mere hothead.
text.28:85: Lo! He Who hath given thee the Qur'an for a law will surely bring thee home again. Say: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance and him who is in error manifest.
text.29:18: But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.
text.29:50: And they say: Why are not portents sent down upon him from his Lord? Say: Portents are with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner.
text.31:11: This is the Creation of Allah. Now show me that which those (ye worship) beside Him have created. Nay, but the wrong-doers are in error manifest!
text.33:36: And it becometh not a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His messenger have decided an affair (for them), that they should (after that) claim any say in their affair; and whoso is rebellious to Allah and His messenger, he verily goeth astray in error manifest.
text.33:58: And those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin.
text.34:3: Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record,
text.34:24: Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest.
text.34:43: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.
text.36:12: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
text.36:17: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
text.36:24: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
text.36:47: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
text.36:60: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
text.36:69: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
text.36:77: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
text.37:15: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
text.37:106: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
text.37:113: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
text.37:156: Or have ye a clear warrant?
text.38:70: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.
text.39:15: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!
text.39:22: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.
text.40:23: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant
text.43:2: By the Scripture which maketh plain,
text.43:15: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
text.43:18: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?
text.43:29: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
text.43:40: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?
text.43:62: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
text.44:2: By the Scripture that maketh plain
text.44:10: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
text.44:13: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
text.44:19: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
text.44:33: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
text.45:30: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
text.46:7: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.
text.46:9: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
text.46:32: And whoso respondeth not to Allah's summoner he can nowise escape in the earth, and he hath no protecting friends instead of Him. Such are in error manifest.
text.48:1: Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory,
text.51:38: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
text.51:50: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
text.51:51: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
text.52:38: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
text.61:6: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic.
text.62:2: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest,

text.67:26: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;
